```dataviewjs
// obsidian-planning v1.0.0 - generated by scripts/build.js - do not edit by hand
// Emoji Constants
// DO NOT EDIT - Use escape sequences from EMOJI_REFERENCE.md
// AI MUST use these constants. NEVER use literal emoji.
// ALL emoji MUST use \u{XXXXXX} format - these are Unicode escape sequences

// Define emoji using Unicode escape sequences
// These are interpreted by JavaScript as the actual Unicode characters
const P0 = '\u{1F53A}';  // U+1F53A: UP-POINTING RED TRIANGLE
const P1 = '\u{23EB}';  // U+23EB: BLACK UP-POINTING DOUBLE TRIANGLE  
const P2 = '\u{1F53C}';  // U+1F53C: UP-POINTING TRIANGLE
const P3 = '\u{1F53D}';  // U+1F53D: DOWN-POINTING TRIANGLE
const P4 = '\u{23EC}';  // U+23EC: BLACK DOWN-POINTING DOUBLE TRIANGLE
const CLOCK_CHAR = '\u{23F1}';  // U+23F1: STOPWATCH
const CHECK_CHAR = '\u{2705}';  // U+2705: GREEN CHECK MARK
const CALENDAR_CHAR = '\u{1F4C5}';  // U+1F4C5: CALENDAR
const ID_CHAR = '\u{1F194}';  // U+1F194: SQUARED CL
const BLOCK_CHAR = '\u{26D4}';  // U+26D4: CROSSED SWORDS

const CLOCK = CLOCK_CHAR;
const CHECK = CHECK_CHAR;
const CALENDAR = CALENDAR_CHAR;
const ID_MARKER = ID_CHAR;
const BLOCK_MARKER = BLOCK_CHAR;

const PRIORITY = {
  P0: P0,
  P1: P1,
  P2: P2,
  P3: P3,
  P4: P4,
};

const PRIORITY_RANK = {
  [P0]: 0,
  [P1]: 1,
  [P2]: 2,
  [P3]: 3,
  [P4]: 4,
};

const PRIORITY_DEFAULT = 2;

// Emoji for each priority rank (reverse of PRIORITY_RANK).
const PRIORITY_BY_RANK = {
  0: P0,
  1: P1,
  2: P2,
  3: P3,
  4: P4,
};

// Map a numeric priority rank to its emoji (defaults to P2).
function priorityEmoji(rank) {
  return PRIORITY_BY_RANK[rank] != null ? PRIORITY_BY_RANK[rank] : PRIORITY_BY_RANK[PRIORITY_DEFAULT];
}

// Regex patterns
// In template literals used with new RegExp(), we need to double-escape backslashes
// \s becomes \\s, \d becomes \\d, etc.

const priorityRe = new RegExp(
  `(${P0}|${P1}|${P2}|${P3}|${P4})\\uFE0F?`,
  'u'
);

const durRe = new RegExp(
  `(${CLOCK_CHAR}:: *(\\d+(?:\\.\\d+)?)h)|${CLOCK_CHAR} *(\\d+(?:\\.\\d+)?)h`,
  'u'
);

const dateRe = new RegExp(
  `${CALENDAR_CHAR}\\s*\\[*\\s*(\\d{4}-\\d{2}-\\d{2})(?:\\s*\\]*\\s*(\\d{1,2}):(\\d{2}))?`,
  'u'
);

const idRe = new RegExp(
  `${ID_CHAR}\\s*([\\w-]+)`,
  'u'
);

// Completion date marker (✅ YYYY-MM-DD). Optional surrounding brackets/spaces are tolerated.
const completionRe = new RegExp(
  `${CHECK_CHAR} *\\[*\\s*([0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2})`,
  'u'
);

const blkRe = new RegExp(
  `${BLOCK_CHAR}\\s*([\\w,\\-\\s]+)`,
  'u'
);

// Helper functions
function parsePriority(text) {
  const pm = text.match(priorityRe);
  return pm ? PRIORITY_RANK[pm[1]] : PRIORITY_DEFAULT;
}

function fmtHours(h) {
  return h.toFixed(1).replace(/\.0$/, '');
}

// --- Completion-date filtering (used by the Completed Tasks month filter) ---

// Parse a "YYYY-MM-DD" completion date into { year: number, month: number(1-12) }, or null.
function completionMonth(compDate) {
  if (!compDate) return null;
  const m = String(compDate).match(/^(\d{4})-(\d{2})/);
  return m ? { year: +m[1], month: +m[2] } : null;
}

// Filter completed tasks to those finished in the given year/month (month is 1-12).
function filterByCompletionMonth(completed, year, month) {
  return (completed || []).filter((t) => {
    const cm = completionMonth(t.compDate);
    return cm && cm.year === year && cm.month === month;
  });
}

// Full completion date key "YYYY-MM-DD", or null if missing/unparseable.
function completionKey(compDate) {
  if (!compDate) return null;
  const m = String(compDate).match(/^(\d{4})-(\d{2})-(\d{2})/);
  return m ? `${m[1]}-${m[2]}-${m[3]}` : null;
}

// True only for a complete "YYYY-MM-DD" date.
function isCompleteDate(v) {
  return /^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(String(v));
}

// Normalize typed input to "YYYY-MM-DD". Accepts a raw digit string ("20260915") or a
// partially typed one; leaves short input untouched so the field stays usable while typing.
// Once the year (4 digits) is present, the month/day are appended exactly as typed
// (slice(4,6)/slice(6,8) keep 1 or 2 digits), so a partial month like "2026-0" or a partial
// day like "2026-09-1" survive instead of being dropped.
function normDate(v) {
  const d = String(v).replace(/\D/g, '');
  if (d.length < 4) return v;
  let out = d.slice(0, 4);
  if (d.length >= 5) out += '-' + d.slice(4, 6);
  if (d.length >= 7) out += '-' + d.slice(6, 8);
  return out;
}

// Inclusive completion-date range filter. Empty bounds are treated as open-ended.
// Dates are compared as "YYYY-MM-DD" strings (lexicographic order == chronological order).
function filterByCompletionRange(completed, startKey, endKey) {
  return (completed || []).filter((t) => {
    const k = completionKey(t.compDate);
    if (!k) return false;
    if (startKey && k < startKey) return false;
    if (endKey && k > endKey) return false;
    return true;
  });
}

// First / last day ("YYYY-MM-DD") of a month (month is 1-12).
function monthStartKey(year, month) {
  return `${year}-${String(month).padStart(2, '0')}-01`;
}
function monthEndKey(year, month) {
  // new Date(year, month, 0) => last day of `month` (month is 1-12).
  const lastDay = new Date(year, month, 0).getDate();
  return `${year}-${String(month).padStart(2, '0')}-${String(lastDay).padStart(2, '0')}`;
}

// The current year/month from a luxon DateTime (has numeric .year/.month) or a native Date.
// Defaults to now when nothing usable is provided.
function currentMonth(today) {
  if (today && typeof today.year === 'number' && typeof today.month === 'number') {
    return { year: today.year, month: today.month };
  }
  const d = today instanceof Date ? today : new Date();
  return { year: d.getFullYear(), month: d.getMonth() + 1 };
}

// Build the markdown line shown for a completed task, e.g.:
//   - [x] Formulaire de demande de formation 📅 [[[2026-09-15](2026-09-15)]] ⏱ 1h ⏫ ✅ 2026-09-15
// Input `t` fields: title, dlStr (YYYY-MM-DD), hours (>0 to show), priority (rank), compDate (YYYY-MM-DD).
function formatCompletedLine(t) {
  const out = ['- [x]'];
  if (t.title) out.push(t.title);
  if (t.dlStr) out.push(`${CALENDAR} [[[${t.dlStr}](${t.dlStr})]]`);
  if (t.hours && t.hours > 0) out.push(`${CLOCK} ${fmtHours(t.hours)}h`);
  out.push(priorityEmoji(t.priority));
  if (t.compDate) out.push(`${CHECK} ${t.compDate}`);
  return out.join(' ');
}

function ownDur(t) {
  const dm = t.text.match(durRe);
  if (!dm) return 0;
  const num = dm[2] || dm[3];
  return num ? parseFloat(num) : 0;
}

function cleanTitle(text) {
  // Remove all metadata markers from the START of text to end of line
  // In Obsidian, metadata appears at the beginning: "📅 2024-01-01 ⏱:: 2h actual task"
  // This pattern removes from the first metadata char to the end
  const metadataChars = `${CALENDAR_CHAR}${ID_CHAR}${BLOCK_CHAR}${P0}${P1}${P2}${P3}${P4}`;
  const metadataPattern = new RegExp(
    `[${metadataChars}\\uFE0F].*`,
    'u'
  );
  return text
    .replace(metadataPattern, '')
    .replace(durRe, '')
    .replace(/\s+/g, ' ')
    .trim();
}

function baseName(p) {
  return p.split('/').pop().replace(/\.md$/, '');
}



// src/utils.js - Shared utility functions for rendering modules
// These are Obsidian/Dataview dependent - not testable outside Obsidian

// Helper functions for HTML escaping
function esc(s) {
  return String(s).replace(/&/g, '&amp;').replace(/</g, '&lt;').replace(/>/g, '&gt;');
}

function escA(s) {
  return String(s).replace(/&/g, '&amp;').replace(/"/g, '&quot;').replace(/</g, '&lt;');
}

function renderMd(s) {
  let h = esc(s);
  h = h.replace(/\*\*(.+?)\*\*/g, '<strong>$1</strong>')
      .replace(/~~(.+?)~~/g, '<del>$1</del>')
      .replace(/`(.+?)`/g, '<code>$1</code>');
  return h;
}

function clip(s, k) {
  return s.length > k ? s.slice(0, k - 1) + '\u2026' : s;
}

// Task opener utility - creates a function to open tasks in Obsidian
function makeTaskOpener(app) {
  function selectLine(path, line, tries) {
    const target = app.workspace.getLeavesOfType('markdown').find(l => 
      l.view && l.view.file && l.view.file.path === path
    );
    if (target && target.view.editor) {
      app.workspace.setActiveLeaf(target, { focus: true });
      const ed = target.view.editor;
      const len = (ed.getLine(line) || '').length;
      ed.setSelection({ line, ch: 0 }, { line, ch: len });
      ed.scrollIntoView({ from: { line, ch: 0 }, to: { line, ch: len } }, true);
      ed.focus();
    }
    else if (tries > 0) setTimeout(() => selectLine(path, line, tries - 1), 50);
  }
  return (el) => {
    el.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
      e.stopPropagation();
      const p = el.getAttribute('data-path');
      const l = parseInt(el.getAttribute('data-line'), 10);
      app.workspace.getLeaf('tab').openFile(app.vault.getAbstractFileByPath(p), { 
        active: true, 
        state: { line: l } 
      });
      selectLine(p, l, 12);
    });
    el.addEventListener('auxclick', (e) => {
      if (e.button === 1) {
        const p = el.getAttribute('data-path');
        const l = parseInt(el.getAttribute('data-line'), 10);
        e.preventDefault();
        e.stopPropagation();
        app.workspace.getLeaf('tab').openFile(app.vault.getAbstractFileByPath(p), { 
          active: true, 
          state: { line: l } 
        });
        selectLine(p, l, 12);
      }
    });
  };
}

// Shared openTask instance (will be initialized in main)
let openTask = null;

// Initialize openTask when dv is available
if (typeof dv !== 'undefined' && dv.app) {
  openTask = makeTaskOpener(dv.app);
}



// src/parser.js - Data collection and parsing for Obsidian tasks
// This file uses dv and Obsidian-specific data structures
// It's NOT testable outside Obsidian


// --- Data Collection ---
function collectAll(pages) {
  const all = [];
  const seen = new Set();
  const warnings = [];
  const completed = [];

  for (const page of pages) {
    const path = page.file.path;
    const file = baseName(path);
    const childKeys = new Set();

    const markChildren = (t) => {
      for (const c of t.subtasks ?? []) {
        childKeys.add(`${path}:${c.line}`);
        markChildren(c);
      }
    };

    for (const t of page.file.tasks) markChildren(t);

    for (const t of page.file.tasks) {
      if (t.status === '-') continue;
      // Completed ([x]) tasks are kept only for the completion log; they are never scheduled.
      if (t.completed) {
        const km = t.text.match(dateRe);
        const dm = t.text.match(completionRe);
        const noComp = t.text.replace(completionRe, '');
        completed.push({
          title: cleanTitle(noComp),
          path,
          file,
          line: t.line,
          dlStr: km ? km[1] : null,
          hours: ownDur(t),
          priority: parsePriority(t.text),
          compDate: dm ? dm[1] : null,
        });
        continue;
      }
      const key = `${path}:${t.line}`;
      if (seen.has(key)) continue;
      seen.add(key);

      const km = t.text.match(dateRe);
      const idm = t.text.match(idRe);
      const blm = t.text.match(blkRe);
      const priority = parsePriority(t.text);
      let ownDL = null;
      let locked = false;
      let mDate = null;
      let mHour = 0;
      let mMin = 0;
      const parsingErrors = [];

      try {
        if (km) {
          if (km[2] != null) {
            locked = true;
            mDate = dv.date(km[1]);
            mHour = +km[2];
            mMin = +km[3];
            if (isNaN(mHour) || mHour < 0 || mHour > 23) parsingErrors.push(`Hour invalid: ${km[2]}`);
            if (isNaN(mMin) || mMin < 0 || mMin > 59) parsingErrors.push(`Minute invalid: ${km[3]}`);
            if (!mDate) parsingErrors.push(`Date parse failed: ${km[1]}`);
          } else {
            ownDL = dv.date(km[1]);
            if (!ownDL) parsingErrors.push(`Date parse failed: ${km[1]}`);
          }
        }
      } catch (e) {
        parsingErrors.push(`Exception: ${e.message}`);
      }

      const dur = ownDur(t);
      if (dur < 0) parsingErrors.push(`Negative duration: ${dur}h`);
      const isIndented = childKeys.has(key);

      const taskEntry = {
        key,
        node: t,
        path,
        file,
        line: t.line,
        ownDL,
        locked,
        mDate,
        mHour,
        mMin,
        graphDL: km ? dv.date(km[1]) : null,
        id: idm ? idm[1].replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9_-]+$/, '') : null,
        deps: blm ? blm[1].split(',').map(s => s.trim().replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9_-]+$/, '')).filter(Boolean) : [],
        title: cleanTitle(t.text),
        priority,
        isIndented,
        _parsingErrors: parsingErrors,
      };

      if (parsingErrors.length) {
        warnings.push({ text: t.text, path, line: t.line, errors: parsingErrors });
      }
      all.push(taskEntry);
    }
  }

  return { all, seen, warnings, completed };
}

// --- Graph Building ---
function buildGraph(all) {
  const dependents = {};
  all.forEach(r => r.deps.forEach(dep => {
    dependents[dep] = dependents[dep] || [];
    dependents[dep].push(r);
  }));

  const minDate = (a, b) => (!a ? b : !b ? a : a < b ? a : b);

  function effectiveDL(item) {
    let best = item.ownDL;
    const vis = new Set([item.key]);
    const stack = [item];
    while (stack.length) {
      const cur = stack.pop();
      best = minDate(best, cur.graphDL);
      if (cur.id && dependents[cur.id]) {
        for (const d of dependents[cur.id]) {
          if (!vis.has(d.key)) {
            vis.add(d.key);
            stack.push(d);
          }
        }
      }
    }
    return best;
  }

  all.forEach(r => r.eff = r.locked ? null : effectiveDL(r));

  function effectivePriority(item) {
    let best = item.priority;
    const vis = new Set([item.key]);
    const stack = [item];
    while (stack.length) {
      const cur = stack.pop();
      best = Math.min(best, cur.priority);
      for (const dep of cur.deps) {
        const depTasks = all.filter(r => r.id === dep);
        for (const dt of depTasks) {
          if (!vis.has(dt.key)) {
            vis.add(dt.key);
            stack.push(dt);
          }
        }
      }
    }
    return best;
  }

  all.forEach(r => r.effPriority = effectivePriority(r));
  const markSet = new Set(all.filter(r => r.eff).map(r => r.key));

  return { dependents, markSet };
}

// --- Chargeable Hours Calculation ---
function chargeableHours(node, path, markSet) {
  let sum = ownDur(node);
  for (const c of node.subtasks ?? []) {
    if (c.completed || c.status === '-') continue;
    if (markSet.has(`${path}:${c.line}`)) continue;
    sum += chargeableHours(c, path, markSet);
  }
  return sum === 0 ? 0.1 : sum;
}

// --- Main Data Collection ---
function collectPlannerData(pages) {
  const { all, warnings, completed } = collectAll(pages);
  const { dependents, markSet } = buildGraph(all);
  const items = [];
  const locks = [];

  for (const r of all) {
    if (r.locked) {
      const h = chargeableHours(r.node, r.path, markSet);
      if (h > 0) {
        locks.push({
          day: r.mDate,
          hour: r.mHour,
          min: r.mMin,
          hours: h,
          title: r.title,
          path: r.path,
          line: r.line,
          file: r.file,
          id: r.id,
          deps: r.deps,
          priority: r.effPriority
        });
      }
      continue;
    }

    if (!r.eff) continue;

    const hours = chargeableHours(r.node, r.path, markSet);
    items.push({
      duration: hours,
      deadline: r.eff,
      title: r.title,
      path: r.path,
      line: r.line,
      file: r.file,
      id: r.id,
      deps: r.deps,
      ownStr: r.ownDL ? r.ownDL.toFormat('yyyy-MM-dd') : '--',
      inherited: !r.ownDL || r.eff < r.ownDL,
      priority: r.effPriority
    });
  }

  return { tasks: all, items, locks, dependents, markSet, warnings, completed };
}



// src/scheduler.js - Scheduling logic (no Obsidian/Dataview dependencies)
// All emoji are imported from constants.js - NEVER use literal emoji

/**
 * Create an allocator for scheduling tasks across work days
 * Pure function - takes configuration and returns allocation functions
 */
function createAllocator(today, workDays, meetIv, SCHEDULE) {
  const freeCache = {};

  function dayFree(di) {
    if (freeCache[di]) return freeCache[di];
    const ms = (meetIv[di] || []).slice().sort((a, b) => a.s - b.s);
    const free = [];
    let c = 0;
    for (const mi of ms) {
      if (mi.s > c) free.push([c, mi.s]);
      c = Math.max(c, mi.e);
    }
    if (c < 1) free.push([c, 1]);
    return (freeCache[di] = free.filter(iv => iv[1] - iv[0] > 1e-9));
  }

  let di = 0;
  let ivs = dayFree(0);
  let fi = 0;
  let pos = ivs[0] ? ivs[0][0] : 1;

  function advance() {
    while (di < workDays.length) {
      while (fi < ivs.length) {
        if (pos < ivs[fi][1] - 1e-9) return true;
        fi++;
        if (fi < ivs.length) pos = ivs[fi][0];
      }
      di++;
      if (di < workDays.length) {
        ivs = dayFree(di);
        fi = 0;
        pos = ivs[0] ? ivs[0][0] : 1;
      }
    }
    return false;
  }

  return {
    allocate: (hours) => {
      const segs = [];
      let rem = hours;
      while (rem > 1e-9 && advance()) {
        const iv = ivs[fi];
        const base = workDays[di].diff(today, 'days').days;
        const availH = (iv[1] - pos) * SCHEDULE.hoursPerDay;
        const take = Math.min(availH, rem);
        const tf = take / SCHEDULE.hoursPerDay;
        segs.push({ calS: base + pos, calE: base + pos + tf });
        pos += tf;
        rem -= take;
      }
      return segs;
    },
    reset: () => {
      di = 0;
      ivs = dayFree(0);
      fi = 0;
      pos = ivs[0] ? ivs[0][0] : 1;
    }
  };
}

/**
 * Check if there's priority inversion among late tasks
 * Late tasks are those where endCal > dlIdx
 * Priority inversion: a higher priority task (lower number) comes after a lower priority task
 */
function hasPriorityInversionAmongLate(sched) {
  const lateTasks = sched.filter(s => s.late);
  if (lateTasks.length < 2) return false;

  // Sort late tasks by their start time in the schedule
  const lateTasksByTime = [...lateTasks].sort((a, b) => a.startCal - b.startCal);

  // Check if any higher priority late task comes after a lower priority late task
  for (let i = 0; i < lateTasksByTime.length; i++) {
    for (let j = i + 1; j < lateTasksByTime.length; j++) {
      // If task j has higher priority (lower number) but comes later (higher startCal)
      if (lateTasksByTime[j].priority < lateTasksByTime[i].priority &&
          lateTasksByTime[j].startCal > lateTasksByTime[i].startCal) {
        return true;
      }
    }
  }
  return false;
}

/**
 * Find the highest priority late task with the earliest deadline that is NOT already locked.
 * Among equal-priority late tasks the earliest deadline wins (a (priority, deadline) order,
 * consistent with the EDF heuristic), not the shortest duration.
 */
function findHighestPriorityEarliestDeadlineLate(sched, lockedKeys) {
  const lateTasks = sched.filter(s => s.late && !lockedKeys.has(`${s.path}:${s.line}`));
  if (lateTasks.length === 0) return null;

  // Find the highest priority (lowest priority number) among late tasks
  const minPriority = Math.min(...lateTasks.map(t => t.priority));
  const highestPriorityLate = lateTasks.filter(t => t.priority === minPriority);

  // Among highest priority late tasks, pick the one with the earliest deadline
  let earliest = highestPriorityLate[0];
  for (const task of highestPriorityLate) {
    if (task.deadline < earliest.deadline) {
      earliest = task;
    }
  }

  return earliest;
}

/**
 * Schedule with EDF (Earliest Deadline First) respecting dependency order.
 * Uses topological sort with deadline constraint: among tasks whose
 * dependencies are all already placed, pick the earliest-deadline one
 * (tie-break: longer duration first).
 *
 * Pure function - takes items, lockedItems, allocator config
 */
function scheduleWithEDF(remainingItems, lockedItems, allocator, today) {
  const lockedWithTimes = [];

  // First, allocate time for locked items (they've been placed first)
  for (const lockedItem of lockedItems) {
    const dlIdx = lockedItem.deadline.diff(today, 'days').days;
    const segs = lockedItem.duration <= 0 ? [{ calS: dlIdx, calE: dlIdx }] : allocator.allocate(lockedItem.duration);
    const startCal = segs.length ? segs[0].calS : dlIdx;
    const endCal = segs.length ? segs[segs.length - 1].calE : dlIdx;
    const late = endCal > dlIdx;

    lockedWithTimes.push({
      ...lockedItem,
      dlIdx,
      segs,
      startCal,
      endCal,
      late
    });
  }

  // Schedule remaining items respecting dependencies (topological EDF)
  const scheduled = new Set(lockedItems.map(it => `${it.path}:${it.line}`));
  const unscheduled = new Map();
  remainingItems.forEach(item => unscheduled.set(`${item.path}:${item.line}`, item));
  const result = [];
  let cycleGuard = scheduled.size + unscheduled.size + 1;

  while (unscheduled.size > 0 && cycleGuard > 0) {
    cycleGuard--;

    // Find ready tasks: all deps already scheduled (or have no deps)
    const ready = [];
    for (const [key, item] of unscheduled) {
      if (item.deps.length === 0 || item.deps.every(dep => scheduled.has(dep))) {
        ready.push(item);
      }
    }

    // If no ready tasks but unscheduled remain, we have a cycle.
    // Fall back to remaining items sorted by deadline (handles orphan deps).
    if (ready.length === 0) {
      for (const item of remainingItems) {
        if (!scheduled.has(`${item.path}:${item.line}`)) {
          const dlIdx = item.deadline.diff(today, 'days').days;
          const segs = item.duration <= 0 ? [{ calS: dlIdx, calE: dlIdx }] : allocator.allocate(item.duration);
          const startCal = segs.length ? segs[0].calS : dlIdx;
          const endCal = segs.length ? segs[segs.length - 1].calE : dlIdx;
          const late = endCal > dlIdx;
          scheduled.add(`${item.path}:${item.line}`);
          result.push({ ...item, dlIdx, segs, startCal, endCal, late });
        }
      }
      break;
    }

    // Among ready tasks, pick earliest deadline; tie-break: longer duration
    ready.sort((a, b) => a.deadline - b.deadline || b.duration - a.duration);
    const chosen = ready[0];
    unscheduled.delete(`${chosen.path}:${chosen.line}`);
    scheduled.add(`${chosen.path}:${chosen.line}`);

    const dlIdx = chosen.deadline.diff(today, 'days').days;
    const segs = chosen.duration <= 0 ? [{ calS: dlIdx, calE: dlIdx }] : allocator.allocate(chosen.duration);
    const startCal = segs.length ? segs[0].calS : dlIdx;
    const endCal = segs.length ? segs[segs.length - 1].calE : dlIdx;
    const late = endCal > dlIdx;

    result.push({ ...chosen, dlIdx, segs, startCal, endCal, late });
  }

  return [...lockedWithTimes, ...result];
}

/**
 * Compute schedule using EDF with iterative priority correction for late tasks
 * Pure function - takes items, locks, today, SCHEDULE config
 * Returns schedule data with today, SCHEDULE, calToDT, idToAll, workDays
 */
function computeSchedule(items, locks, today, SCHEDULE) {
  // Setup work days and meetings
  let sStart = today;
  while (sStart.weekday > 5) sStart = sStart.plus({ days: 1 });

  const totalWH = items.reduce((s, it) => s + it.duration, 0) + locks.reduce((s, l) => s + l.hours, 0);
  const needWD = Math.ceil(totalWH / (SCHEDULE.hoursPerDay / 2)) + 6;
  const workDays = [];
  let d = sStart;
  let guard = 0;
  while (workDays.length < needWD && guard++ < 9000) {
    if (d.weekday <= 5) workDays.push(d);
    d = d.plus({ days: 1 });
  }

  const wdIndex = {};
  workDays.forEach((d, i) => wdIndex[d.toFormat('yyyy-MM-dd')] = i);

  const meetIv = {};
  const meetData = [];

  locks.forEach(lk => {
    const i = wdIndex[lk.day.toFormat('yyyy-MM-dd')];
    const sc = lk.hour + lk.min / 60;
    // (Unclamped) intra-day start/end fraction. A meeting past working hours keeps its
    // true position so the Gantt bar extends past the day's end into the next working
    // day (the user knows the meeting time and it must be enforced).
    const s = (sc - SCHEDULE.startHour) / SCHEDULE.hoursPerDay;
    const e = s + lk.hours / SCHEDULE.hoursPerDay;
    // Working-time lock: clamp to the day's [0,1] so only in-hours time is reserved;
    // a meeting that starts past the working day reserves no extra working time.
    const lockS = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, s));
    const lockE = Math.max(lockS, Math.min(1, e));
    const dayIdx = lk.day.diff(today, 'days').days;
    lk.calS = dayIdx + s;
    lk.calE = dayIdx + e;
    if (i != null) (meetIv[i] = meetIv[i] || []).push({ s: lockS, e: lockE });
    meetData.push({ ...lk });
  });

  // Iterative scheduling with priority correction
  let remainingItems = [...items];
  let lockedItems = [];
  let lockedKeys = new Set();
  let finalSched = [];

  const maxIterations = items.length * 2;
  let iteration = 0;

  while (iteration < maxIterations) {
    iteration++;

    const allocator = createAllocator(today, workDays, meetIv, SCHEDULE);
    finalSched = scheduleWithEDF(remainingItems, lockedItems, allocator, today);

    // Check if there's priority inversion among late tasks
    if (!hasPriorityInversionAmongLate(finalSched)) {
      break;
    }

    // Find the highest priority late task with the earliest deadline that is NOT already locked
    const taskToLock = findHighestPriorityEarliestDeadlineLate(finalSched, lockedKeys);

    if (!taskToLock) {
      break;
    }

    // Lock this task
    const taskKey = `${taskToLock.path}:${taskToLock.line}`;
    lockedKeys.add(taskKey);
    remainingItems = remainingItems.filter(item =>
      `${item.path}:${item.line}` !== taskKey
    );
    lockedItems.push(taskToLock);
  }

  const sched = finalSched;

  // Build lookup maps
  const idToAll = {};
  sched.forEach(s => { if (s.id) idToAll[s.id] = s; });
  meetData.forEach(l => { if (l.id) idToAll[l.id] = l; });

  // A meeting (lock) is a fixed block and cannot itself be late. But tasks that
  // must be performed BEFORE the meeting are its prerequisites (lk.deps). If any
  // prerequisite task is late, the meeting is flagged as displayLate so the UI
  // can highlight it exactly like a late task (its prep work didn't finish on time).
  locks.forEach(lk => {
    let late = false;
    for (const dep of lk.deps || []) {
      const depTask = idToAll[dep];
      if (depTask && depTask.late) { late = true; break; }
    }
    lk.displayLate = late;
  });

  // Calendar utilities
  function calToDT(cal) {
    const dayOff = Math.floor(cal + 1e-9);
    const frac = cal - dayOff;
    return today.plus({
      days: dayOff,
      hours: SCHEDULE.startHour,
      minutes: Math.round(frac * SCHEDULE.hoursPerDay * 60)
    });
  }

  return { sched, meetData: locks, today, SCHEDULE, calToDT, idToAll, workDays };
}



// src/capacity.js - Capacity calculation logic
// All emoji are imported from constants.js - NEVER use literal emoji

/**
 * Compute capacity data for visualization
 * Pure function - takes items, locks, today, SCHEDULE config
 * Returns capacity data object
 */
function computeCapacity(items, locks, today, SCHEDULE) {
  // Find date range
  const lastDeadline = items.reduce((mx, it) => (it.deadline > mx ? it.deadline : mx), today);
  const firstDeadline = items.reduce((mn, it) => (it.deadline < mn ? it.deadline : mn), lastDeadline);
  const range = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(lastDeadline.diff(today, 'days').days));
  const startDate = firstDeadline < today ? firstDeadline : today;
  const endDate = today.plus({ days: 2 * range });
  const totalDays = Math.max(1, Math.round(endDate.diff(startDate, 'days').days));
  const t0 = Math.round(today.diff(startDate, 'days').days);

  // Calculate meeting hours per day
  const meetH = {};
  locks.forEach(lk => {
    const k = lk.day.toFormat('yyyy-MM-dd');
    meetH[k] = (meetH[k] || 0) + lk.hours;
  });

  // Build date array and labels
  const dateArr = [];
  const labels = [];
  const values = [];
  const capHours = new Array(totalDays + 1);

  for (let d = 0; d <= totalDays; d++) {
    const date = startDate.plus({ days: d });
    dateArr.push(date);
    labels.push(date.toFormat('yyyy-MM-dd'));
  }

  // Calculate cumulative capacity hours
  capHours[t0] = 0;
  for (let i = t0 + 1; i <= totalDays; i++) {
    const dk = dateArr[i].toFormat('yyyy-MM-dd');
    capHours[i] = capHours[i - 1] + (dateArr[i].weekday <= 5 ? Math.max(0, SCHEDULE.hoursPerDay - (meetH[dk] || 0)) : 0);
  }
  for (let i = t0 - 1; i >= 0; i--) capHours[i] = 0;

  // Calculate demand and values
  for (let d = 0; d <= totalDays; d++) {
    const demand = items.filter(it => it.deadline <= dateArr[d]).reduce((s, it) => s + it.duration, 0);
    values.push(capHours[d] - demand);
  }

  // Calculate forward minimum (worst deficit from this point onward)
  let fwdMin = Infinity;
  for (let d = totalDays; d >= 0; d--) {
    fwdMin = Math.min(fwdMin, values[d]);
    values[d] = fwdMin;
  }

  // Build marks data for visualization
  const marksData = items.map(it => ({
    i: Math.round(it.deadline.diff(startDate, 'days').days),
    date: it.deadline.toFormat('yyyy-MM-dd'),
    title: it.title,
    hours: it.duration,
    path: it.path,
    line: it.line,
    file: it.file,
    inherited: it.inherited,
    ownStr: it.ownStr,
    priority: it.priority
  }));

  // Group by day
  const byDay = {};
  marksData
    .sort((a, b) => a.date < b.date ? -1 : a.date > b.date ? 1 : a.title.localeCompare(b.title))
    .forEach(d => {
      if (!byDay[d.i]) byDay[d.i] = [];
      byDay[d.i].push(d);
    });

  // Calculate max stack height
  let maxStack = 1;
  Object.values(byDay).forEach(arr => {
    let acc = 0;
    arr.forEach(d => {
      d.accBelow = acc;
      acc += d.hours;
    });
    if (acc > maxStack) maxStack = acc;
  });

  return { values, labels, dateArr, byDay, maxStack, totalDays, t0, startDate };
}



// src/render/capacity_chart.js - Capacity chart rendering (Obsidian/Dataview dependent)
// This file uses dv and app - not testable outside Obsidian



/**
 * Render Capacity chart
 * Depends on: dv, app, and capacity data
 */
function renderCapacity(container, capacityData, SCHEDULE) {
  const { values, labels, dateArr, byDay, maxStack, totalDays, t0 } = capacityData;
  const pinned = new Set();
  const panel = container.createEl('div');

  function renderPanel() {
    if (!pinned.size) { panel.innerHTML = ''; return; }
    const targetIdx = Math.max(...pinned);
    const targetDate = labels[targetIdx];
    const dueOn = byDay[targetIdx]?.slice().sort((a, b) => b.hours - a.hours) || [];
    const earlier = Object.values(byDay).flat().filter(d => d.i < targetIdx).sort((a, b) => a.i - b.i || b.hours - a.hours);
    const sum = (arr) => arr.reduce((s, d) => s + d.hours, 0);
    const row = (d) => `<div class="prow" data-path="${escA(d.path)}" data-line="${d.line}" style="cursor:pointer;padding:3px 6px;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(128,128,128,0.15);"><span style="color:${d.inherited ? 'rgb(224,108,117)' : 'rgb(97,175,239)'};font-weight:600;">${esc(d.date)}</span> - ${renderMd(d.title)} <b>(${fmtHours(d.hours)}h)</b><span style="color:gray;font-size:11px;"> - ${esc(d.file)}${d.inherited ? ` - own:${esc(d.ownStr)}` : ''}</span></div>`;
    const list = (arr) => arr.length ? arr.map(row).join('') : `<div style="color:gray;padding:3px 6px;">none</div>`;
    panel.innerHTML = `<div style="margin-top:10px;font-size:13px;border:1px solid rgba(128,128,128,0.25);border-radius:6px;overflow:hidden;"><div style="padding:6px 8px;background:rgba(97,175,239,0.12);font-weight:700;">To meet ${esc(targetDate)} - ${sum(dueOn)}h due that day + ${sum(earlier)}h earlier = <span style="color:rgb(224,108,117);">${sum(dueOn) + sum(earlier)}h total</span></div><div style="padding:5px 8px 2px;font-weight:600;">Tasks due on ${esc(targetDate)} (${dueOn.length} - ${sum(dueOn)}h)</div>${list(dueOn)}<div style="padding:8px 8px 2px;font-weight:600;">Earlier deadlines to clear first (${earlier.length} - ${sum(earlier)}h)</div>${list(earlier)}</div>`;
    panel.querySelectorAll('.prow').forEach(el => openTask(el));
  }

  const m = { l: 60, r: 20, t: 34, b: 78 };
  const baseIH = 150;
  const n = values.length;
  const ymin = Math.min(0, -maxStack, ...values);
  const ymax = Math.max(0, ...values);
  const span = ymax - ymin || 1;
  const basePxPerDay = Math.max(5, 685 / totalDays);
  let scaleX = 1;
  let scaleY = 1;
  let lastY0 = 0;

  const bar = container.createEl('div');
  bar.style.cssText = 'margin-bottom:6px;display:flex;gap:6px;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap;';
  bar.createEl('span', { text: 'X' }).style.cssText = 'font-size:12px;color:gray;';
  const xOut = mkBtn(bar, '-');
  const xReset = mkBtn(bar, 'reset');
  const xIn = mkBtn(bar, '+');
  bar.createEl('span', { text: '  Y' }).style.cssText = 'font-size:12px;color:gray;';
  const yOut = mkBtn(bar, '-');
  const yIn = mkBtn(bar, '+');
  const clearBtn = mkBtn(bar, 'clear selection');
  bar.createEl('span', { text: '  (click calendar to select a deadline)' }).style.cssText = 'color:gray;font-size:12px;';

  const scroll = container.createEl('div');
  scroll.style.cssText = 'overflow:auto;width:100%;max-height:540px;border:1px solid rgba(128,128,128,0.2);';

  function mkBtn(host, t) {
    const b = host.createEl('button', { text: t });
    b.style.cssText = 'cursor:pointer;padding:2px 8px;';
    return b;
  }

  const halo = document.body.classList.contains('theme-dark') ? 'rgb(0,0,0)' : 'rgb(255,255,255)';

  function draw() {
    const pxPerDay = basePxPerDay * scaleX;
    const iw = totalDays * pxPerDay;
    const ih = baseIH * scaleY;
    const H = m.t + ih + m.b;
    const W = m.l + m.r + iw;
    const xAt = (i) => m.l + i * pxPerDay;
    const yAt = (v) => m.t + ih - ((v - ymin) / span) * ih;
    const barW = Math.max(3, Math.min(16, pxPerDay * 0.6));
    const yZero = yAt(0);
    lastY0 = yZero;

    let dPath = `M ${xAt(0)} ${yAt(values[0])}`;
    for (let i = 1; i < n; i++) {
      dPath += ` L ${xAt(i)} ${yAt(values[i - 1])} L ${xAt(i)} ${yAt(values[i])}`;
    }

    let g = '';
    for (let k = 0; k <= 5; k++) {
      const v = ymin + (span * k) / 5;
      const y = yAt(v);
      g += `<line x1="${m.l}" y1="${y}" x2="${W - m.r}" y2="${y}" stroke="rgba(128,128,128,0.15)"/><text x="${m.l - 8}" y="${y + 4}" font-size="12" text-anchor="end" fill="gray">${v.toFixed(0)}h</text>`;
    }

    let weeks = '';
    let months = '';
    for (let d = 0; d <= totalDays; d++) {
      const dt = dateArr[d];
      const x = xAt(d);
      if (dt.day === 1) {
        months += `<line x1="${x}" y1="${m.t}" x2="${x}" y2="${m.t + ih}" stroke="rgba(128,128,128,0.5)"/><text x="${x + 3}" y="${m.t + ih + 36}" font-size="12" fill="gray">${dt.toFormat('yyyy-MM')}</text>`;
      } else if (dt.weekday === 1) {
        weeks += `<line x1="${x}" y1="${m.t}" x2="${x}" y2="${m.t + ih}" stroke="rgba(128,128,128,0.18)"/>`;
      }
      if (dt.weekday > 5 && d < totalDays) {
        weeks += `<rect x="${x}" y="${m.t}" width="${pxPerDay}" height="${ih}" fill="rgba(128,128,128,0.1)" pointer-events="none"/>`;
      }
    }

    const step = Math.max(1, Math.round(totalDays / Math.max(1, Math.floor(iw / 90))));
    for (let d = 0; d <= totalDays; d += step) {
      g += `<text x="${xAt(d)}" y="${H - m.b + 18}" font-size="12" text-anchor="middle" fill="gray">${labels[d]}</text>`;
    }

    let marks = '';
    Object.keys(byDay).map(Number).sort((a, b) => a - b).forEach(dayIdx => {
      const arr = byDay[dayIdx];
      const x = xAt(dayIdx);
      const on = pinned.has(dayIdx);
      const lineCol = on ? 'rgb(97,175,239)' : 'rgba(97,175,239,0.5)';
      const vis = on ? 'visible' : 'hidden';
      let segs = '';
      let lbls = '';
      arr.forEach((dm, k) => {
        const yTop = yAt(-dm.accBelow);
        const yBot = yAt(-(dm.accBelow + dm.hours));
        const h = yBot - yTop;
        const fill = dm.inherited ? 'rgba(224,108,117,0.85)' : 'rgba(97,175,239,0.85)';
        segs += `<rect x="${x - barW / 2}" y="${yTop}" width="${barW}" height="${Math.max(1, h)}" fill="${fill}" stroke="rgba(80,80,80,0.7)" pointer-events="none"/>`;
        if (h > 18) segs += `<text x="${x}" y="${(yTop + yBot) / 2 + 4}" font-size="12" text-anchor="middle" fill="gray" pointer-events="none">${fmtHours(dm.hours)}h</text>`;
        const extra = dm.inherited ? ` - own:${dm.ownStr}` : '';
        lbls += `<text class="lbl" data-path="${escA(dm.path)}" data-line="${dm.line}" x="${x + 9}" y="${m.t + 28 + k * 17}" font-size="12" fill="rgb(97,175,239)" stroke="${halo}" stroke-width="3" paint-order="stroke" cursor="pointer" visibility="${vis}">${esc(dm.date)} - ${esc(dm.title)} (${fmtHours(dm.hours)}h) - ${esc(dm.file)}${esc(extra)}</text>`;
      });
      marks += `<g class="mk" data-day="${dayIdx}"><line class="mkline" x1="${x}" y1="${m.t}" x2="${x}" y2="${m.t + ih}" stroke="${lineCol}" pointer-events="none"/>${segs}<rect class="toggle" x="${x - 9}" y="${m.t - 2}" width="18" height="18" fill="transparent" cursor="pointer"/><text x="${x}" y="${m.t + 12}" font-size="13" text-anchor="middle" pointer-events="none">${CALENDAR}</text>${lbls}</g>`;
    });

    const todayLine = `<line x1="${xAt(t0)}" y1="${m.t}" x2="${xAt(t0)}" y2="${m.t + ih}" stroke="rgb(152,195,121)" stroke-width="2" pointer-events="none"/><text x="${xAt(t0) + 3}" y="${m.t + ih - 4}" font-size="12" fill="rgb(152,195,121)" pointer-events="none">today</text>`;
    scroll.innerHTML = `<svg viewBox="0 0 ${W} ${H}" width="${W}" height="${H}" style="display:block">${weeks}${months}${g}${marks}${todayLine}<line x1="${m.l}" y1="${yZero}" x2="${W - m.r}" y2="${yZero}" stroke="rgb(136,136,136)" stroke-dasharray="4 4"/><path d="${dPath}" fill="none" stroke="rgb(224,108,117)" stroke-width="2"/><text x="${m.l}" y="18" font-size="12" fill="gray">Hours owed vs. weekday-${SCHEDULE.hoursPerDay}h capacity (meetings reduce capacity) - red bar = inherited deadline</text></svg>`;

    scroll.querySelectorAll('.mk').forEach(gEl => {
      const day = parseInt(gEl.dataset.day, 10);
      const lbls = gEl.querySelectorAll('.lbl');
      const line = gEl.querySelector('.mkline');
      const toggle = gEl.querySelector('.toggle');
      const apply = () => {
        const on = pinned.has(day);
        lbls.forEach(l => l.setAttribute('visibility', on ? 'visible' : 'hidden'));
        line.setAttribute('stroke', on ? 'rgb(97,175,239)' : 'rgba(97,175,239,0.5)');
      };
      toggle.addEventListener('click', () => {
        if (pinned.has(day)) pinned.delete(day); else pinned.add(day);
        apply(); renderPanel();
      });
      lbls.forEach(el => openTask(el));
    });
  }

  function zoomX(f, r) {
    const before = scroll.scrollLeft + (r ?? 0.5) * scroll.clientWidth;
    const oldW = totalDays * basePxPerDay * scaleX;
    scaleX = Math.min(30, Math.max(0.4, scaleX * f));
    draw();
    const newW = totalDays * basePxPerDay * scaleX;
    if (oldW > 0) scroll.scrollLeft = before * (newW / oldW) - (r ?? 0.5) * scroll.clientWidth;
  }

  function zoomY(f, r) {
    const before = scroll.scrollTop + (r ?? 0.5) * scroll.clientHeight;
    const oldH = baseIH * scaleY;
    scaleY = Math.min(20, Math.max(0.4, scaleY * f));
    draw();
    const newH = baseIH * scaleY;
    if (oldH > 0) scroll.scrollTop = before * (newH / oldH) - (r ?? 0.5) * scroll.clientHeight;
  }

  xIn.onclick = () => zoomX(1.3, 0.5);
  xOut.onclick = () => zoomX(1 / 1.3, 0.5);
  xReset.onclick = () => { scaleX = 1; scaleY = 1; draw(); scroll.scrollLeft = 0; };
  yIn.onclick = () => zoomY(1.3, 0.5);
  yOut.onclick = () => zoomY(1 / 1.3, 0.5);
  clearBtn.onclick = () => { pinned.clear(); draw(); renderPanel(); };

  scroll.addEventListener('wheel', (e) => {
    if (e.ctrlKey) {
      e.preventDefault();
      zoomX(e.deltaY < 0 ? 1.15 : 1 / 1.15, (e.clientX - scroll.getBoundingClientRect().left) / scroll.clientWidth);
    }
    else if (e.altKey) {
      e.preventDefault();
      zoomY(e.deltaY < 0 ? 1.15 : 1 / 1.15, (e.clientY - scroll.getBoundingClientRect().top) / scroll.clientHeight);
    }
  }, { passive: false });

  draw();
  renderPanel();
  requestAnimationFrame(() => {
    scroll.scrollLeft = t0 * basePxPerDay - scroll.clientWidth / 2;
    scroll.scrollTop = lastY0 - scroll.clientHeight / 2;
  });
}



// src/render/gantt.js - Gantt chart rendering (Obsidian/Dataview dependent)
// This file uses dv and app - not testable outside Obsidian




/**
 * Render Gantt chart
 * Depends on: dv, app, and schedule data
 */
function renderGantt(container, scheduleData) {
  const { sched, meetData, today, SCHEDULE, calToDT, idToAll } = scheduleData;
  const gm = { top: 42, lab: 270, r: 20 };
  const maxCal = Math.max(...sched.map(s => Math.max(s.endCal, s.dlIdx + 1)), ...meetData.map(l => l.calE), 1);
  const gDays = Math.ceil(maxCal) + 3;

  // Build tree structure for grouping
  const root = { id: '', label: '', children: new Map(), items: [] };
  function segsOf(path) {
    const p = path.replace(/\.md$/, '');
    const parts = p.split('/');
    if (parts[0] === 'Projets') parts.shift();
    if (parts.length >= 2 && parts[parts.length - 1] === parts[parts.length - 2]) parts.pop();
    return parts.length ? parts : ['(root)'];
  }
  function addEntry(path, en) {
    const parts = segsOf(path);
    let node = root;
    let idAcc = '';
    parts.forEach(seg => {
      idAcc += (idAcc ? '/' : '') + seg;
      if (!node.children.has(seg)) {
        node.children.set(seg, { id: idAcc, label: seg, children: new Map(), items: [] });
      }
      node = node.children.get(seg);
    });
    node.items.push(en);
  }
  sched.forEach(s => addEntry(s.path, { k: 'task', s, start: s.startCal }));
  meetData.forEach(l => addEntry(l.path, { k: 'meet', l, start: l.calS }));

  function nodeTotal(node) {
    let sum = 0;
    for (const en of node.items) sum += en.k === 'task' ? (en.s.duration || 0) : (en.l.hours || 0);
    for (const c of node.children.values()) sum += nodeTotal(c);
    return sum;
  }
  function annotateTotals(node) {
    node.total = nodeTotal(node);
    node.children.forEach(c => annotateTotals(c));
  }
  annotateTotals(root);

  function nodeStart(node) {
    let mn = Infinity;
    node.items.forEach(e => mn = Math.min(mn, e.start));
    node.children.forEach(c => mn = Math.min(mn, nodeStart(c)));
    return mn === Infinity ? 0 : mn;
  }
  function collectEntries(node, out) {
    node.items.forEach(e => out.push(e));
    node.children.forEach(c => collectEntries(c, out));
    return out;
  }

  const collapsed = new Set();
  function flatten(node, depth, out) {
    const kids = [...node.children.values()].sort((a, b) => nodeStart(a) - nodeStart(b));
    for (const c of kids) {
      out.push({ type: 'group', node: c, depth });
      if (!collapsed.has(c.id)) {
        flatten(c, depth + 1, out);
        c.items.slice().sort((a, b) => a.start - b.start).forEach(en =>
          out.push(en.k === 'task' ? { type: 'task', s: en.s, depth: depth + 1 } : { type: 'meet', l: en.l, depth: depth + 1 })
        );
      }
    }
  }

  const gbar = container.createEl('div');
  gbar.style.cssText = 'margin:4px 0;display:flex;gap:6px;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap;';
  gbar.createEl('span', { text: 'X' }).style.cssText = 'font-size:12px;color:gray;';
  const gxOut = mkBtn(gbar, '\u2212');
  const gxReset = mkBtn(gbar, 'reset');
  const gxIn = mkBtn(gbar, '+');
  gbar.createEl('span', { text: '  rows' }).style.cssText = 'font-size:12px;color:gray;';
  const gyOut = mkBtn(gbar, '\u2212');
  const gyIn = mkBtn(gbar, '+');
  const collapseAll = mkBtn(gbar, 'fold all');
  const expandAll = mkBtn(gbar, 'unfold all');
  gbar.createEl('span', { text: `  (\u25b8/\u25be fold \u25a6 Planning row stacks all)` }).style.cssText = 'color:gray;font-size:12px;';
  const gscroll = container.createEl('div');
  gscroll.style.cssText = 'overflow:auto;width:100%;max-height:460px;border:1px solid rgba(128,128,128,0.2);';

  const basePxG = Math.max(6, 900 / gDays);
  let gScaleX = 1;
  let gRowH = 24;

  function allGroupIds(node, acc) {
    node.children.forEach(c => { acc.push(c.id); allGroupIds(c, acc); });
    return acc;
  }

  function drawGantt() {
    sched.forEach(s => s.__row = null);
    meetData.forEach(l => l.__row = null);
    const visible = [];
    flatten(root, 0, visible);
    visible.push({ type: 'planning', depth: 0 });
    const pxG = basePxG * gScaleX;
    const rh = gRowH;
    const W = gm.lab + gDays * pxG + gm.r;
    const H = gm.top + visible.length * rh + 16;
    const xAt = (c) => gm.lab + c * pxG;
    const midY = (ri) => gm.top + ri * rh + rh / 2;

    let axis = '';
    let grid = '';
    for (let d = 0; d <= gDays; d++) {
      const dt = today.plus({ days: d });
      const x = xAt(d);
      if (dt.day === 1) {
        grid += `<line x1="${x}" y1="${gm.top}" x2="${x}" y2="${H - 16}" stroke="rgba(128,128,128,0.5)"/>`;
        axis += `<text x="${x + 3}" y="${gm.top - 22}" font-size="12" fill="gray">${dt.toFormat('yyyy-MM')}</text>`;
      } else if (dt.weekday === 1) {
        grid += `<line x1="${x}" y1="${gm.top}" x2="${x}" y2="${H - 16}" stroke="rgba(128,128,128,0.15)"/>`;
      } else if (dt.weekday > 5) {
        grid += `<rect x="${x}" y="${gm.top}" width="${pxG}" height="${H - 16 - gm.top}" fill="rgba(128,128,128,0.07)"/>`;
      }
    }
    const step = Math.max(1, Math.round(gDays / Math.max(1, Math.floor((gDays * pxG) / 90))));
    for (let d = 0; d <= gDays; d += step) {
      axis += `<text x="${xAt(d)}" y="${gm.top - 5}" font-size="11" text-anchor="middle" fill="gray">${today.plus({ days: d }).toFormat('MM-dd')}</text>`;
    }

    const meetBar = (l, y, ri, setRow = true) => {
      if (setRow) l.__row = ri;
      const x1 = xAt(l.calS);
      const w = Math.max(4, xAt(l.calE) - x1);
      const late = l.displayLate;
      const fill = late ? 'rgb(224,108,117)' : 'rgba(198,120,221,0.9)';
      const stroke = late ? 'rgb(150,0,0)' : 'rgba(255,255,255,0.6)';
      const sw = late ? 2 : 1;
      const tag = late ? '(late \u2014 prerequisite late)' : '(locked)';
      return `<rect class="gbar" data-path="${escA(l.path)}" data-line="${l.line}" x="${x1}" y="${y}" width="${w}" height="${rh - 8}" rx="3" fill="${fill}" stroke="${stroke}" stroke-width="${sw}" cursor="pointer"><title>${esc(l.title)} \u00b7 ${l.day.toFormat('yyyy-MM-dd')} ${String(l.hour).padStart(2, '0')}:${String(l.min).padStart(2, '0')} \u00b7 ${fmtHours(l.hours)}h ${tag}</title></rect>`;
    };

    const taskBars = (s, y, ri, setRow = true) => {
      if (setRow) s.__row = ri;
      let fill, stroke, strokeWidth;
      if (s.late) {
        if (s.priority === 3 || s.priority === 4) { fill = 'rgb(128,128,128)'; stroke = 'rgb(64,64,64)'; strokeWidth = 2; }
        else if (s.priority === 2) { fill = 'rgb(255,165,80)'; stroke = 'rgb(200,120,40)'; strokeWidth = 2; }
        else { fill = 'rgb(224,108,117)'; stroke = 'rgb(150,0,0)'; strokeWidth = 2; }
      } else { fill = 'rgba(97,175,239,0.9)'; stroke = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.6)'; strokeWidth = 1; }
      let o = '';
      s.segs.forEach(seg => {
        const x1 = xAt(seg.calS);
        const w = Math.max(2, xAt(seg.calE) - x1);
        o += `<rect class="gbar" data-path="${escA(s.path)}" data-line="${s.line}" x="${x1}" y="${y}" width="${w}" height="${rh - 8}" rx="2" fill="${fill}" stroke="${stroke}" stroke-width="${strokeWidth}" cursor="pointer"><title>${esc(s.title)} \u00b7 ${s.duration}h \u00b7 due ${esc(s.deadline.toFormat('yyyy-MM-dd'))}${s.late ? ' \u00b7 LATE' : ''}</title></rect>`;
      });
      return o;
    };

    let rows = '';
    visible.forEach((r, ri) => {
      const y = gm.top + ri * rh;
      const ind = 6 + r.depth * 14;
      if (r.type === 'planning') {
        rows += `<line x1="0" y1="${y}" x2="${W}" y2="${y}" stroke="rgba(128,128,128,0.5)"/><rect x="0" y="${y}" width="${W}" height="${rh}" fill="rgba(229,192,123,0.18)"/><text x="6" y="${y + rh / 2 + 4}" font-size="12" font-weight="700" fill="rgb(209,154,102)" pointer-events="none">\u25a6 Planning</text>`;
        sched.forEach(s => rows += taskBars(s, y + 5, ri, false));
        meetData.forEach(l => rows += meetBar(l, y + 5, ri, false));
        return;
      }
      if (r.type === 'group') {
        const c = r.node;
        const isColl = collapsed.has(c.id);
        const tri = isColl ? '\u25b8' : '\u25be';
        const isLeaf = c.children.size === 0;
        const icon = isLeaf ? '\u{1F4C4}' : '\u{1F4C1}';
        const col = isLeaf ? 'rgb(152,195,121)' : 'rgb(97,175,239)';
        const bg = isLeaf ? 'rgba(152,195,121,0.10)' : 'rgba(97,175,239,0.10)';
        rows += `<rect x="0" y="${y}" width="${W}" height="${rh}" fill="${bg}"/> <text x="${ind}" y="${y + rh / 2 + 4}" font-size="12" fill="${col}" pointer-events="none">${tri} ${icon} ${esc(clip(c.label, Math.max(8, 34 - r.depth * 3)))} <tspan fill="gray">(${fmtHours(c.total)}h)</tspan></text>`;
        if (isColl) {
          collectEntries(c, []).forEach(en => {
            if (en.k === 'task') rows += taskBars(en.s, y + 5, ri);
            else rows += meetBar(en.l, y + 5, ri);
          });
        }
        rows += `<rect class="gfold" data-node="${escA(c.id)}" x="0" y="${y}" width="${gm.lab}" height="${rh}" fill="transparent" cursor="pointer"/>`;
        return;
      }
      rows += `<line x1="0" y1="${y + rh}" x2="${W}" y2="${y + rh}" stroke="rgba(128,128,128,0.12)"/>`;
      if (r.type === 'meet') {
        const l = r.l;
        const late = l.displayLate;
        const textColor = late ? 'rgb(224,108,117)' : 'rgb(198,120,221)';
        const lateTag = late ? ' \u00b7 <tspan font-weight="bold">LATE</tspan>' : '';
        rows += `<text class="glabel" data-path="${escA(l.path)}" data-line="${l.line}" x="${ind + 6}" y="${y + rh / 2 + 4}" font-size="12" fill="${textColor}" cursor="pointer">\u{1F4CC} ${esc(clip(l.title, Math.max(6, 26 - r.depth * 3)))} (${fmtHours(l.hours)}h)${lateTag}</text>` + meetBar(l, y + 4, ri);
        return;
      }
      const s = r.s;
      const textColor = s.late ? (s.priority === 3 || s.priority === 4 ? 'rgb(128,128,128)' : (s.priority === 2 ? 'rgb(255,165,80)' : 'rgb(224,108,117)')) : 'gray';
      rows += `<text class="glabel" data-path="${escA(s.path)}" data-line="${s.line}" x="${ind + 6}" y="${y + rh / 2 + 4}" font-size="12" fill="${textColor}" cursor="pointer">${esc(clip(s.title, Math.max(6, 26 - r.depth * 3)))} (${fmtHours(s.duration)}h)</text>` + taskBars(s, y + 4, ri);
      const dx = xAt(s.dlIdx);
      rows += `<line x1="${dx}" y1="${y + 2}" x2="${dx}" y2="${y + rh - 2}" stroke="${s.late ? 'rgb(224,108,117)' : 'rgb(152,195,121)'}" stroke-width="2" stroke-dasharray="3 2" pointer-events="none"/>`;
    });

    let arrows = '';
    sched.forEach(s => {
      if (s.__row == null) return;
      s.deps.forEach(dep => {
        const p = idToAll[dep];
        if (!p || !p.__row || p.__row === s.__row) return;
        const ex = xAt(p.endCal);
        const ey = midY(p.__row);
        const sx = xAt(s.startCal);
        const sy = midY(s.__row);
        arrows += `<path d="M ${ex} ${ey} C ${ex + 18} ${ey}, ${sx - 18} ${sy}, ${sx - 2} ${sy}" fill="none" stroke="rgb(230,160,60)" stroke-width="1.6"/><polygon points="${sx},${sy} ${sx - 8},${sy - 4} ${sx - 8},${sy + 4}" fill="rgb(230,160,60)"/>`;
      });
    });
    meetData.forEach(l => {
      if (l.__row == null) return;
      l.deps.forEach(dep => {
        const p = idToAll[dep];
        if (!p || !p.__row || p.__row === l.__row) return;
        const exVal = p.duration !== undefined ? p.endCal : p.calE;
        const ex = xAt(exVal);
        const ey = midY(p.__row);
        const sx = xAt(l.calS);
        const sy = midY(l.__row);
        arrows += `<path d="M ${ex} ${ey} C ${ex + 18} ${ey}, ${sx - 18} ${sy}, ${sx - 2} ${sy}" fill="none" stroke="rgb(230,160,60)" stroke-width="1.6"/><polygon points="${sx},${sy} ${sx - 8},${sy - 4} ${sx - 8},${sy + 4}" fill="rgb(230,160,60)"/>`;
      });
    });
    const todayL = `<line x1="${xAt(0)}" y1="${gm.top}" x2="${xAt(0)}" y2="${H - 16}" stroke="rgb(152,195,121)" stroke-width="2"/>`;
    gscroll.innerHTML = `<svg viewBox="0 0 ${W} ${H}" width="${W}" height="${H}" style="display:block"><rect x="0" y="0" width="${gm.lab}" height="${H}" fill="rgba(128,128,128,0.04)"/>${grid}${todayL}${axis}${rows}${arrows}</svg>`;
    gscroll.querySelectorAll('.gbar').forEach(el => openTask(el));
    gscroll.querySelectorAll('.glabel').forEach(el => openTask(el));
    gscroll.querySelectorAll('.gfold').forEach(el => el.addEventListener('click', () => {
      const id = el.getAttribute('data-node');
      if (collapsed.has(id)) collapsed.delete(id); else collapsed.add(id);
      drawGantt();
    }));
  }

  function gZoomX(f, r) {
    const before = gscroll.scrollLeft + (r ?? 0.5) * gscroll.clientWidth;
    const oldW = gDays * basePxG * gScaleX;
    gScaleX = Math.min(30, Math.max(0.4, gScaleX * f));
    drawGantt();
    const newW = gDays * basePxG * gScaleX;
    if (oldW > 0) gscroll.scrollLeft = before * (newW / oldW) - (r ?? 0.5) * gscroll.clientWidth;
  }

  function mkBtn(host, t) {
    const b = host.createEl('button', { text: t });
    b.style.cssText = 'cursor:pointer;padding:2px 8px;';
    return b;
  }

  gxIn.onclick = () => gZoomX(1.3, 0.5);
  gxOut.onclick = () => gZoomX(1 / 1.3, 0.5);
  gxReset.onclick = () => { gScaleX = 1; gRowH = 24; drawGantt(); gscroll.scrollLeft = 0; };
  gyIn.onclick = () => { gRowH = Math.min(48, gRowH + 4); drawGantt(); };
  gyOut.onclick = () => { gRowH = Math.max(14, gRowH - 4); drawGantt(); };
  collapseAll.onclick = () => { allGroupIds(root, []).forEach(id => collapsed.add(id)); drawGantt(); };
  expandAll.onclick = () => { collapsed.clear(); drawGantt(); };

  gscroll.addEventListener('wheel', (e) => {
    if (e.ctrlKey) {
      e.preventDefault();
      gZoomX(e.deltaY < 0 ? 1.15 : 1 / 1.15, (e.clientX - gscroll.getBoundingClientRect().left) / gscroll.clientWidth);
    }
    else if (e.altKey) {
      e.preventDefault();
      gRowH = Math.min(48, Math.max(14, gRowH + (e.deltaY < 0 ? 2 : -2)));
      drawGantt();
    }
  }, { passive: false });

  drawGantt();
  return { sched, calToDT };
}



// src/render/execution_list.js - Execution list rendering (Obsidian/Dataview dependent)
// This file uses dv and app - not testable outside Obsidian



/**
 * Render execution list
 * Depends on: dv, app, and schedule data
 */
function renderExecutionList(container, seq, calToDT) {
  const planDiv = container.createEl('div');
  planDiv.style.cssText = 'font-size:13px;border:1px solid rgba(128,128,128,0.25);border-radius:6px;overflow:hidden;';
  let prevDate = null;
  const lines = [];

  seq.forEach((e, i) => {
    // Meetings keep their requested calendar date (a post-working-hours meeting must
    // show on that day, not roll to the next). Other rows fall back to startCal.
    const dateStr = e.meetDateStr || calToDT(e.startCal).toFormat('ccc dd LLL');
    const showDate = dateStr !== prevDate;
    if (showDate) prevDate = dateStr;

    let col, lateStyle;
    if (e.kind === 'meet') {
      if (e.late) {
        col = e.priority === 3 || e.priority === 4 ? 'rgb(128,128,128)' : (e.priority === 2 ? 'rgb(255,165,80)' : 'rgb(224,108,117)');
        lateStyle = 'background:rgba(224,108,117,0.1);';
      } else { col = 'rgb(198,120,221)'; lateStyle = ''; }
    }
    else if (e.late) {
      if (e.priority === 3 || e.priority === 4) { col = 'rgb(128,128,128)'; lateStyle = 'background:rgba(128,128,128,0.1);'; }
      else if (e.priority === 2) { col = 'rgb(255,165,80)'; lateStyle = 'background:rgba(255,165,80,0.1);'; }
      else { col = 'rgb(224,108,117)'; lateStyle = 'background:rgba(224,108,117,0.1);'; }
    } else { col = 'rgb(97,175,239)'; lateStyle = ''; }

    const dueTxt = e.kind === 'meet' ? 'fixed' : `due ${esc(e.dl)}`;

    if (showDate) {
      lines.push(`<div style="background:rgba(97,175,239,0.08);padding:3px 8px;font-weight:600;color:rgb(97,175,239);font-size:12px;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(128,128,128,0.2);">${esc(dateStr)}</div>`);
    }

    lines.push(`<div class="prow" data-path="${escA(e.path)}" data-line="${e.line}" style="cursor:pointer;padding:3px 6px;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(128,128,128,0.15);${lateStyle}"><span style="color:${col};font-weight:bold;float:left;width:24px;text-align:right;margin-right:8px;">${i + 1}.</span><div style="overflow:hidden;"><div style="margin-bottom:1px;">${renderMd(e.title)} <b>(${fmtHours(e.hours)}h)</b></div><div style="color:gray;font-size:11px;">${esc(e.file)} \u00b7 ${dueTxt}${e.late ? ' \u00b7 <b>LATE</b>' : ''}</div></div></div>`);
  });

  planDiv.innerHTML = lines.join('');
  planDiv.querySelectorAll('.prow').forEach(el => openTask(el));
}



// src/render/ignored.js - Ignored tasks rendering (Obsidian/Dataview dependent)
// This file uses dv and app - not testable outside Obsidian


/**
 * Get reason why a task was ignored
 */
function getIgnoreReason(d) {
  if (!d.ownDL && !d.graphDL) return 'no deadline or inherited deadline';
  if (!d.ownDL) return 'no own deadline and inherited deadline is invalid';
  if (d.locked) return 'locked task';
  return 'no effective deadline';
}

/**
 * Render ignored tasks
 * Depends on: dv, app, and ignored tasks list
 */
function renderIgnored(container, ignored) {
  const dropDiv = container.createEl('div');
  dropDiv.style.cssText = 'font-size:13px;border:1px solid rgba(128,128,128,0.25);border-radius:6px;overflow:hidden;';
  dropDiv.innerHTML = ignored.slice(0, 10).map((d, idx) => `
    <div class="prow" data-path="${escA(d.path)}" data-line="${d.line}" 
         style="cursor:pointer;display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:baseline;padding:4px 8px;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(128,128,128,0.15);">
      <span style="color:rgb(224,108,117);font-weight:bold;">${idx + 1}.</span>
      <div style="flex:1;">
        <div>${renderMd(d.title)}</div>
        <div style="color:gray;font-size:11px;margin-top:2px;">ignored: ${esc(getIgnoreReason(d))}</div>
      </div>
    </div>`).join('');

  dropDiv.querySelectorAll('.prow').forEach(el => openTask(el));

  if (ignored.length > 10) {
    dropDiv.createEl('div', { text: `... and ${ignored.length - 10} more ignored tasks.` })
      .style.cssText = 'padding:5px;color:gray;font-size:12px;text-align:center;';
  }
  else if (ignored.length === 0) {
    dropDiv.createEl('div', { text: 'No first-class undone tasks found that were filtered out.' })
      .style.cssText = 'padding:5px;color:gray;font-size:12px;text-align:center;';
  }
}



// src/render/parsing_errors.js - Parsing errors rendering (Obsidian/Dataview dependent)
// This file uses dv and app - not testable outside Obsidian


/**
 * Render parsing errors
 * Depends on: dv, app, and warnings list
 */
function renderParsingErrors(container, warnings) {
  const errDiv = container.createEl('div');
  errDiv.style.cssText = 'font-size:13px;border:1px solid rgba(128,128,0.25);border-radius:6px;overflow:hidden;';

  if (!warnings.length) {
    errDiv.createEl('div', { text: 'No parsing errors found - all task metadata is valid.' })
      .style.cssText = 'padding:5px;color:gray;font-size:12px;text-align:center;';
    return;
  }

  const rows = warnings.map((e, idx) => {
    const errorList = e.errors.map(err => `<span style="color:rgb(224,108,117);font-size:11px;">${esc(err)}</span>`).join(' \u00b7 ');
    return `<div class="prow" data-path="${escA(e.path)}" data-line="${e.line}" style="cursor:pointer;padding:4px 8px;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(128,128,0.15);">
      <span style="color:rgb(255,165,0);font-weight:bold;min-width:24px;display:inline-block;text-align:right;margin-right:8px;">${idx + 1}.</span>
      <div style="overflow:hidden;">
        <div style="margin-bottom:2px;">${renderMd(e.text)}</div>
        <div style="color:gray;font-size:11px;">${esc(e.file)} \u00b7 L${e.line} \u00b7 ${errorList}</div>
      </div>
    </div>`;
  });

  errDiv.innerHTML = rows.join('');
  errDiv.querySelectorAll('.prow').forEach(el => openTask(el));

  if (warnings.length > 10) {
    errDiv.createEl('div', { text: `... and ${warnings.length - 10} more parsing errors.` })
      .style.cssText = 'padding:5px;color:gray;font-size:12px;text-align:center;';
  }
}



// src/render/completed.js - Completed tasks tree (Obsidian/Dataview dependent)
// Renders finished ([x]) tasks as a foldable project/subproject tree that mirrors the
// FIRST COLUMN of the Gantt chart: group headers with cumulative hours, task rows with
// individual hours, ▸/▾ fold/unfold, depth indentation, click-to-open tasks.
//
// Example output (group header + task rows):
//   ▾ 📂 Formation (3.25h)
//     Formulaire de demande de formation (1h) ✅ 2026-09-15
//   ▸ 📂 Budget (1.5h)
//
// This is a direct copy of the gantt.js first-column logic, fed with the completed list.



/**
 * Render completed tasks as a foldable tree by project/subproject.
 * Depends on: dv, app, and the completed-tasks list (from the parser).
 *
 * @param {HTMLElement} container
 * @param {Array<{path:string, line:number, title:string, hours:number, compDate:string|null}>} completed
 * @param {DateTime|Date} today
 */
function renderCompleted(container, completed, today) {
  const geo = { pad: 6, step: 14, max: 460 };

  const box = container.createEl('div');
  box.style.cssText = 'font-size:13px;border:1px solid rgba(128,128,128,0.2);border-radius:6px;overflow:hidden;margin-top:4px;';

  // Only tasks that have a completion date are ever shown.
  const done = (completed || []).filter(t => t.compDate);

  if (!done.length) {
    box.innerHTML = '<div style="padding:8px;color:gray;font-size:12px;text-align:center;">No completed tasks found.</div>';
    return;
  }

  // Default range = the current month (From = 1st, To = last day).
  const cur = currentMonth(today);
  const startKey = monthStartKey(cur.year, cur.month);
  const endKey = monthEndKey(cur.year, cur.month);

  // --- Build the project/subproject tree (near-identical to gantt.js first column) ---
  const cRoot = { id: '', label: '', children: new Map(), items: [] };

  function cSegsOf(path) {
    const p = path.replace(/\.md$/, '');
    const parts = p.split('/');
    if (parts[0] === 'Projets') parts.shift();
    if (parts.length >= 2 && parts[parts.length - 1] === parts[parts.length - 2]) parts.pop();
    return parts.length ? parts : ['(root)'];
  }
  function cStartOf(t) {
    // Order completed tasks within a branch by completion date (the gantt uses scheduling start).
    const d = t.compDate ? Date.parse(t.compDate) : 0;
    return Number.isFinite(d) ? d : 0;
  }
  function cAddEntry(path, en) {
    const parts = cSegsOf(path);
    let node = cRoot;
    let idAcc = '';
    parts.forEach(seg => {
      idAcc += (idAcc ? '/' : '') + seg;
      if (!node.children.has(seg)) {
        node.children.set(seg, { id: idAcc, label: seg, children: new Map(), items: [] });
      }
      node = node.children.get(seg);
    });
    node.items.push(en);
  }

  // Cumulative hours for a node = sum of its task hours + all descendant group totals.
  function cNodeTotal(node) {
    let sum = 0;
    for (const en of node.items) sum += en.s.hours || 0;
    for (const c of node.children.values()) sum += cNodeTotal(c);
    return sum;
  }
  function cAnnotate(node) {
    node.total = cNodeTotal(node);
    node.children.forEach(c => cAnnotate(c));
  }

  // Earliest completion date among a node's descendants (used to sort branches).
  function cNodeStart(node) {
    let mn = Infinity;
    node.items.forEach(e => mn = Math.min(mn, e.start));
    node.children.forEach(c => mn = Math.min(mn, cNodeStart(c)));
    return mn === Infinity ? 0 : mn;
  }

  const cCollapsed = new Set();
  function cFlatten(node, depth, out) {
    const kids = [...node.children.values()].sort((a, b) => cNodeStart(a) - cNodeStart(b));
    for (const c of kids) {
      out.push({ type: 'group', node: c, depth });
      if (!cCollapsed.has(c.id)) {
        cFlatten(c, depth + 1, out);
        c.items.slice().sort((a, b) => a.start - b.start).forEach(en =>
          out.push(en.k === 'task' ? { type: 'task', s: en.s, depth: depth + 1 } : null)
        );
      }
    }
    return out;
  }

  function cGroupRow(c, depth) {
    const isColl = cCollapsed.has(c.id);
    const tri = isColl ? '\u25b8' : '\u25be';
    const isLeaf = c.children.size === 0;
    const icon = isLeaf ? '\u{1F4C4}' : '\u{1F4C1}';
    const col = isLeaf ? 'rgb(152,195,121)' : 'rgb(97,175,239)';
    const bg = isLeaf ? 'rgba(152,195,121,0.10)' : 'rgba(97,175,239,0.10)';
    const ind = geo.pad + depth * geo.step;
    const label = esc(clip(c.label, Math.max(8, 34 - depth * 3)));
    return (
      `<div class="cgroup" data-node="${escA(c.id)}" data-label="${escA(c.label)}" ` +
      `style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:4px;padding:3px 8px;padding-left:${ind}px;` +
      `border-bottom:1px solid rgba(128,128,128,0.1);background:${bg};cursor:pointer;">` +
      `<span style="color:${col}">${tri}</span><span style="color:${col}">${icon}</span>` +
      `<span style="color:${col};flex:1;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap;">${label}</span>` +
      `<span style="color:gray;font-size:12px;white-space:nowrap;">(${fmtHours(c.total)}h)</span></div>`
    );
  }

  function cTaskRow(t, depth) {
    const ind = geo.pad + depth * geo.step;
    const title = esc(clip(t.title, Math.max(6, 26 - depth * 3)));
    const date = t.compDate ? `<span style="color:gray;font-size:12px;white-space:nowrap;"> ${CHECK} ${esc(t.compDate)}</span>` : '';
    return (
      `<div class="crow" data-path="${escA(t.path)}" data-line="${t.line}" ` +
      `style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:4px;padding:3px 8px;padding-left:${ind}px;` +
      `border-bottom:1px solid rgba(128,128,128,0.1);">` +
      `<span style="color:gray;flex:1;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap;cursor:pointer;">${title} (${fmtHours(t.hours)}h)</span>` +
      `${date}</div>`
    );
  }

  function rowsHtml() {
    const rows = cFlatten(cRoot, 0, []);
    let html = '';
    rows.forEach(r => {
      if (r.type === 'group') html += cGroupRow(r.node, r.depth);
      else if (r.type === 'task') html += cTaskRow(r.s, r.depth);
    });
    return html;
  }

  // Rebuild the tree from a visible (already date-filtered) task list and recompute totals.
  function build(visible) {
    cRoot.id = '';
    cRoot.label = '';
    cRoot.children = new Map();
    cRoot.items = [];
    visible.forEach(t => cAddEntry(t.path, { k: 'task', s: t, start: cStartOf(t) }));
    cAnnotate(cRoot);
  }

  // The text field is authoritative for reading the range; it falls back to the default
  // (current month) when empty/incomplete.
  function readRange() {
    const ts = box.querySelectorAll('.cdate-start-text');
    const te = box.querySelectorAll('.cdate-end-text');
    const s = ts.length ? ts[0].value : '';
    const e = te.length ? te[0].value : '';
    return { start: isCompleteDate(s) ? s : startKey, end: isCompleteDate(e) ? e : endKey };
  }

  // Build the toolbar with the CURRENT range baked into the inputs, so a rebuild does not
  // discard a user's selection.
  function buildToolbar(start, end) {
    return '<div style="margin:4px 0;display:flex;gap:6px;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap;">' +
      '<label style="font-size:12px;color:var(--text-muted);">From</label>' +
      `<input class="cdate-start-date" type="date" value="${start}" style="padding:2px 18px 2px 4px;width:140px;">` +
      `<input class="cdate-start-text" type="text" inputmode="date" pattern="[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}" maxlength="10" value="${start}" style="padding:2px 4px;width:110px;">` +
      '<label style="font-size:12px;color:var(--text-muted);">To</label>' +
      `<input class="cdate-end-date" type="date" value="${end}" style="padding:2px 18px 2px 4px;width:140px;">` +
      `<input class="cdate-end-text" type="text" inputmode="date" pattern="[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}" maxlength="10" value="${end}" style="padding:2px 4px;width:110px;">` +
      '<button type="button" class="cfoldall" style="cursor:pointer;padding:2px 8px;">fold all</button>' +
      '<button type="button" class="cunfoldall" style="cursor:pointer;padding:2px 8px;">unfold all</button></div>';
  }

  const listWrap = '<div style="overflow:auto;max-height:' + geo.max + 'px;">';

  function render() {
    const { start, end } = readRange();
    const visible = filterByCompletionRange(done, start, end);
    build(visible);

    box.innerHTML = buildToolbar(start, end) + listWrap + rowsHtml() + '</div>';

    // Re-bind handlers after each rebuild (querySelectorAll is a no-op in the test mock).
    box.querySelectorAll('.cfoldall').forEach(b => b.onclick = () => {
      cFlatten(cRoot, 0, []).filter(r => r.type === 'group').forEach(r => cCollapsed.add(r.node.id));
      render();
    });
    box.querySelectorAll('.cunfoldall').forEach(b => b.onclick = () => { cCollapsed.clear(); render(); });
    box.querySelectorAll('.cgroup').forEach(g => g.addEventListener('click', () => {
      const id = g.getAttribute('data-node');
      if (!id) return;
      if (cCollapsed.has(id)) cCollapsed.delete(id); else cCollapsed.add(id);
      render();
    }));
    box.querySelectorAll('.crow').forEach(el => openTask(el));

    // Date filters: typing a date (or picking one in the calendar) re-filters the tree and
    // keeps the date/text fields in sync. Each date field sits right after its text field,
    // so a text field's previous sibling is its date field and vice versa.
    box.querySelectorAll('.cdate-start-text, .cdate-end-text').forEach(f =>
      f.addEventListener('input', e => {
        const el = e.currentTarget;
        if (isCompleteDate(el.value)) {
          const dateEl = el.previousElementSibling;
          if (dateEl) dateEl.value = el.value;
          render();
        }
      }),
    );
    box.querySelectorAll('.cdate-start-date, .cdate-end-date').forEach(f =>
      f.addEventListener('change', e => {
        const el = e.currentTarget;
        const textEl = el.nextElementSibling;
        if (textEl) textEl.value = el.value;
        render();
      }),
    );
  }

  render();
}



// src/execution_sequence.js - Build the execution-order sequence (tasks + meetings).
// Pure, testable. `sched` entries come from computeSchedule; `locks` are meetings.
// `today` is the schedule's reference DateTime (luxon).

// Task row for the execution list.
function taskRow(s) {
  return {
    kind: 'task',
    startCal: s.startCal,
    endCal: s.endCal,
    title: s.title,
    hours: s.duration,
    path: s.path,
    line: s.line,
    file: s.file,
    late: s.late,
    dl: s.deadline.toFormat('dd LLL yyyy'),
    priority: s.priority
  };
}

// Meeting row. A meeting past working hours must stay on its requested calendar date
// (it must NOT roll to the next day): clamp its display start into its own working day
// so it groups under `meetDateStr`, and carry the requested date for the date header.
function meetRow(l, today) {
  const dayIdx = l.day.diff(today, 'days').days;
  const dispStart = Math.max(dayIdx, Math.min(l.calS, dayIdx + 1 - 1e-9));
  return {
    kind: 'meet',
    startCal: dispStart,
    endCal: l.calE,
    title: l.title,
    hours: l.hours,
    path: l.path,
    line: l.line,
    file: l.file,
    late: l.displayLate,
    priority: l.priority,
    dl: l.day.toFormat('dd LLL yyyy'),
    meetDateStr: l.day.toFormat('ccc dd LLL')
  };
}

// Tasks and meetings interleaved in chronological (cal) order.
function buildExecutionSequence(sched, locks, today) {
  return [
    ...sched.map(taskRow),
    ...locks.map(l => meetRow(l, today))
  ].sort((a, b) => a.startCal - b.startCal);
}



// src/index.js - Main orchestrator for Obsidian DataviewJS
// This is the entry point that gets wrapped in ```dataviewjs ```
// It uses dv, dv.app, and other Obsidian APIs

// Import all modules











// =============================================
// MAIN EXECUTION
// =============================================

const pages = dv.pages('"Projets"');

// Collect all planner data
const { tasks: all, items, locks, dependents, markSet, warnings: parsingWarnings, completed } = collectPlannerData(pages);

const today = dv.date('today');
const SCHEDULE_CONFIG = { startHour: 9, hoursPerDay: 8 };

if (!items.length) {
  dv.paragraph('No tasks with a duration and an (own or inherited) deadline found.');
} else {
  // --- Duplicate ID Warning ---
  const idCounts = new Map();
  all.forEach(t => { if (t.id == null) return; idCounts.set(t.id, (idCounts.get(t.id) || 0) + 1); });
  const dupIds = [...idCounts.entries()].filter(([, n]) => n > 1).map(([id]) => id).sort();
  if (dupIds.length) {
    const dupWarn = dv.container.createEl('div', { text: '' });
    dupWarn.style.cssText = 'margin-top:12px;font-weight:700;font-size:13px;color:rgb(224,108,117);';
    dupWarn.innerHTML = `\u26a0 Duplicate task id${dupIds.length > 1 ? 's' : ''}: ${dupIds.map(id => `${id} (${idCounts.get(id)}\u00d7)`).join(', ')}`;
  }

  // ===== LOGIC PHASE =====
  const scheduleData = computeSchedule(items, locks, today, SCHEDULE_CONFIG);
  const capacityData = computeCapacity(items, locks, today, SCHEDULE_CONFIG);

  // ===== DEFICIT SUMMARY (needs schedule results) =====
  const { sched } = scheduleData;
  const deficitSummary = dv.container.createEl('div', { text: '' });
  deficitSummary.style.cssText = 'margin-top:12px;font-weight:700;font-size:13px;color:rgb(224,108,117);';
  const late = sched.filter(s => s.late).length;
  const planned = items.reduce((s, it) => s + it.duration, 0);
  const peakDeficit = capacityData.values.length ? -Math.min(0, ...capacityData.values) : 0;
  deficitSummary.innerHTML = `${late} late ${late === 1 ? 'task' : 'tasks'} \u2014 peak deficit ${fmtHours(peakDeficit)}h \u2014 ${fmtHours(planned)}h planned`;

  // ===== RENDERING PHASE =====
  const wrap = dv.container.createEl('div');

  // Capacity Chart
  dv.container.createEl('div', { text: 'Capacity Chart' }).style.cssText = 'margin-top:16px;font-weight:700;font-size:13px;';
  renderCapacity(wrap, capacityData, SCHEDULE_CONFIG);

  // Gantt Chart
  dv.container.createEl('div', { text: `EDF schedule (single resource \u2014 weekday ${SCHEDULE_CONFIG.hoursPerDay}h \u2014 meetings fixed)` }).style.cssText = 'margin-top:16px;font-weight:700;font-size:13px;';
  renderGantt(wrap, scheduleData);

  // Execution List
  const seq = buildExecutionSequence(sched, locks, today);
  dv.container.createEl('div', { text: 'Planning \u2014 execution order' }).style.cssText = 'margin-top:16px;font-weight:700;font-size:13px;';
  renderExecutionList(wrap, seq, scheduleData.calToDT);

  // Ignored Tasks
  const ignored = all.filter(r => !r.isIndented && !r.locked && !r.eff);
  dv.container.createEl('div', { text: 'Ignored first-class undone tasks (to review, correct or delete)' }).style.cssText = 'margin-top:16px;font-weight:700;font-size:13px;color:rgb(224,108,117);';
  renderIgnored(dv.container, ignored);

  // Parsing Errors
  dv.container.createEl('div', { text: 'Parsing errors (tasks with malformed metadata)' }).style.cssText = 'margin-top:16px;font-weight:700;font-size:13px;color:rgb(255,165,0);';
  renderParsingErrors(dv.container, parsingWarnings);
}

// ===== COMPLETED TASKS (always rendered, at the very end) =====
dv.container.createEl('div', { text: 'Completed tasks' }).style.cssText = 'margin-top:24px;font-weight:700;font-size:13px;';
renderCompleted(dv.container, completed, today);
```
